attempts.summary: Deployed a sandboxed systemd service `inventory-worker` on node1 that runs a long-lived loop writing heartbeat lines every 5s into /var/lib/inventory/inventory.log. Confinement uses DynamicUser + StateDirectory=inventory + ProtectSystem=strict + ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory + NoNewPrivileges=yes plus a broad set of additional systemd sandbox hardening options. Verified writes outside the allowed path fail (read-only filesystem) and privilege escalation (sudo) is blocked by NoNewPrivs. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-reboot boot_id and healthy service state, rebooted node1 natively, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and confirmed the service auto-started (enabled) with a new PID and resumed writing to the same data file.
